title: Malaysian Curry Oysters
description: A spicy and savory dish featuring oysters in a warm, earthy Malaysian curry sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add ginger and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add curry powder and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add fish sauce and sugar, and stir to combine.
Add chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Add oysters and cook, covered, until they open, about 3-5 minutes.
Serve oysters in curry sauce, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
